rules.sentence: So, it is advised that physicians consider the impact of NC-AE medications when evaluating patients with HIV and concurrent neurocognitive symptoms.[65]
HIV infection was associated with neurocognitive adverse effects (NC-AE) medication use, which may influence the determinations of HIV-associated neurocognitive impairment.
So, it is advised that physicians consider the impact of NC-AE medications when evaluating patients with HIV and concurrent neurocognitive symptoms.[65]
